item.title: iOS 26.3 and macOS 26.3 Fix Dozens of Vulnerabilities, Including Zero-Day
item.description:
📝 Apple says that the updates address dozens of vulnerabilities, including one that is known to have been actively exploited. There are numerous other vulnerabilities that were also fixed across not only iOS, iPadOS, and macOS, but also Apple's other platforms that saw updates released today. Now that these vulnerabilities have been publicized by Apple, even those that were not exploited before might be taken advantage of now.
